name: stroke-join-miter
description: A miter corner between two thick stroke segments.
useCase: Choose a miter join for a vector path corner.
misuse: Label the control when the editing context is unclear.

16.reason: The open corner sample keeps the inner elbow and the outer corner distinct within the square drawing frame.

24.reason: The wider inner elbow preserves the visible difference between the square, curved and clipped outer corners.
